s.note: the bowls on the kitchen bench at Jules's party
s.how: Cook 2 sliced onions in 30g butter for 40 minutes until deep and jammy, then cool and chop. Fold into 200g sour cream and 100g cream cheese with salt, pepper and chives. Serve with a big bag of ridged potato chips.

s.note: the two cops who take McLovin along for the ride
s.how: Warm 8 cake doughnuts at 160C for 2 minutes. Dip four in a glaze of 150g icing sugar, 2 tbsp milk and vanilla. Toss the rest in sugar mixed with cinnamon. Hand them out like the cops are in on it.

m.note: the long way home after the party
m.how: Roll 800g beef mince into 8 balls and smash thin on a smoking griddle. Flip after 90 seconds, add American cheese and stack two per soft bun with pickles, onion and mustard.

w.note: the end of school, the last night together
w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate with 150g butter. Whisk 3 eggs with 250g sugar until glossy, fold in the chocolate, 80g flour and 30g cocoa. Bake at 170C for 25 minutes so the middle stays fudgy. Cool before cutting.

d.note: the punch bowl at Jules's party
d.how: Pour 500ml pineapple juice and 500ml orange juice into a big bowl with lots of ice. Top with 750ml lemonade and add sliced oranges. Ladle into cups.
